title: 天皇賞（春）の後に・Der Blitz

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Running with emotion makes Eishin Flash realize something for the first time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her rivals may have unyielding tenacity and what it takes to make the final step toward victory, but Eishin Flash desires to surpass them and become number one.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And when she's chosen to be highlighted in a special article, she vows not only to be a "flash" of greatness, but a lasting light that will shine on to the very end.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even as the "end" of her schedule looms on the horizon, I continue to push Eishin Flash toward her greatest goal—the autumn Tenno Sho.
